name: Waterfront Station

references.note: Daderot, own photograph, 23 June 2015 (CC0): round cream hall columns, deep cream ceiling coffers with blue-gray recesses, rose upper frieze and round end-wall clock. Original geometric interpretation; spacing, size and clock time are representative, not surveyed. No photograph or mural is used as a game texture.

First-hand Kenneth Chan / Daily Hive photograph of Howe fare hall, 2018: five gate lanes, six housings, perforated side panels and low flat ceiling. Exact gate offset along the mapped middle level remains representative.
Actual indoor Cordova entry way continues northeast from surveyed door1692226746. Together with outside approach364284185 it fixes the public doorway normal independently of the rail frame.
Existing heritage station building footprint constrains the long hall axis and public nave footprint. Interior wall offsets, pillars and the short rear Expo annex remain representative.
Survey-tagged West Cordova public entrance, wheelchair=yes; actual primary anchor replaces the unreferenced legacy repository point.

Current Granville escalator portal, explicitly described as escalator entrance. It is about 2.8 m from the separate stairs entrance in the official GTFS teaching example; those are not interchangeable survey coordinates.

Official teaching example separately identifies Granville stairs90, escalator91, lift92, Cordova93 and Howe94. Granville stairs90 is used for that stair doorway; current survey-tagged OSM takes precedence for Cordova over teaching-example93.
Official December 2020 BCRTC report, page 2: two east-end escalators, two at Howe street and one up escalator between the platform and the Howe bank.
Official existing Howe lower-landing photograph: central stair, flanking escalators, low ceiling and mall-left direction.
Official Expo east-bank project: Howe remains alternate Expo access; no accessible elevator route via Howe.
First-hand Waterfront 42 upper and 24 lower stair riser count; dimensional section inferred, not survey.
Existing Howe upper stairs and connected mapped lower stair/tunnel geometry.
Mapped three-bend underground walkway between the heritage hall and Canada Line concourse.
Heritage hall serves both lines; Granville entrance serves Canada Line; Howe access serves Expo only.
Operator photographs: southwest heritage-hall entrance, escalator to separate ticketing concourse, platform descent at far side.
Operator construction photographs distinguish concourse, platform and under-Cordova passage.
Photograph of installed station diagram; separate perpendicular island platforms and heritage-hall interchange.
Actual Expo island: large cream columns, low metallic soffit, long fluorescent strips and red rails.
Actual Canada island: dark track walls, pale modular ceiling, rectangular floor tiles and central escalator well.

authoredInterior.accuracy: Reference-backed passenger topology and visible architecture; dimensions and placement are not a survey.

heritageHallOrientation.status: Entry normal and hall axis follow mapped public footways and existing building footprint. Inner nave dimensions, columns and short rear Expo annex are representative; mapped stairs, lifts and boarding assemblies stay fixed.

publicInteriorLinks.accuracy: Retained existing SkyWalk endpoint; nave-to-bridge grade and covered connector proportions inferred, not surveyed.

howeFareBoundary.placementBasis: The photographed fare boundary belongs after the mapped unpaid commercial T-junction and before the lower platform flight. Exact centreline offset and hall width are representative, not a measured gate coordinate.

mappedHorizontalBasis.sourceHorizontalGeometryRebase: Only the primary threshold changes; all secondary doors, platforms and track assemblies retain their source X/Z coordinates so the new geographic anchor/rebase preserves their world position
mappedHorizontalBasis.expoOrientationBasis: Retain the established GTFS tangent and fixed geographic station frame; approximate OSM polygon differs by 0.168 degrees, about 23 cm over 80 m
mappedHorizontalBasis.canadaActiveExtent: 44 m retained boarding profile placed toward the Hastings/Granville end of the mapped box; exact active/reserve boundary inferred

verticalInference.status: Integrated photo/step-count/terrain section; not surveyed interior floor elevations
verticalInference.canadaNorthRiserCountBasis: 24 is the representative shared section; the first-hand 2024 count directly documents the Granville/south route, not an independent north-bank measurement.
verticalInference.underCordovaGradeBasis: Mean rise over the mapped run; the overlap inside the transfer arrival room remains level through its real portal.

canadaNorthLiftAisle.status: Representative island-side aisle section; its two walking anchors remain on the passenger side of the retained train-protection wall. Cabin and boarding geometry stay fixed; exact corridor offset is not surveyed.

verticalInference.limitations: Ground DEM is not a basement survey. The 42/24 first-hand count constrains a 7/4 m stair section. The mapped under-Cordova passage has a level overlap within the arrival room, then a continuous inferred ramp to reconcile that section with the photographed heritage descent; local gradients and room offsets are not surveyed.
verticalInference.datumBasis: Survey-tagged OSM Cordova node1692226746 replaces the unreferenced legacy repository door; all existing station-frame geometry receives one rigid vertical shift to preserve world heights and every verified stair rise
verticalInference.thresholdBasis: The surveyed door ground sample is 44.6 mm above the retained inferred hall slab. This traversable threshold is not an interior slab survey or an extra hidden stair flight.

unverifiedDetails: Howe fare-boundary exact offset is representative; its five lanes and six housings follow the first-hand 2018 photograph, and the mall branch remains unpaid.

Howe lower escalator side, middle-landing elevations and unmeasured widths are representative; its two-bank topology, upper central stair/flanking escalators and mall-left branch are reference-backed.
Canada platform active/reserve boundary within the longer mapped station box is inferred; the complete 44 m boarding assembly remains rigid.
Granville street-to-concourse and concourse-to-island lift cores are separate so the accessible route never crosses tracks at platform height. The interior island-core position is inferred.
Cordova Canada lift cabin is placed beside the mapped escalator bank with a short enclosed bypass; cabin footprint and precise lower portal require an as-built survey.

Poster artwork is original neutral geometry. Commercial mall interiors beyond the documented Howe access mouth are not reconstructed; its opaque scope closure is an inferred model boundary, not a surveyed commercial doorway.
